label: Diagram 3.2
caption: Diagram 3.2 Ceiling treatments A, B and C
description:
A vertical stack of four horizontal cross-sections under the heading "Diagram 3.2 Ceiling treatments A, B and C", with the word "SECTION" at the lower right.

First, "Ceiling treatment A (independent joists)": a horizontal base line with two vertical members at the left and right ends, each drawn as a rectangle crossed by an X; between them a row of overlapping loop shapes (insulation) sits on the base line.

Second, "Ceiling treatment B (resilient bars)": a horizontal base line carrying a row of loop shapes along most of its length; at the left end the loops stop, leaving a small gap with a tiny block and a short line slanting up to the left.

Third, "Ceiling treatment C (timber battens)": a bare horizontal line with two small squares, each containing an X, spaced apart.

Fourth, "Ceiling treatment C (resilient channels)": a horizontal line with a small square block at the left end, followed by a row of loop shapes filling the remainder.
